text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- King Hassan and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak agree on a meeting of the Jerusalem Committee of the Organisation of the Islamic Conference soon to discuss Israeli settlement plans in the holy city. The two leaders also set up a joint committee to boost bilateral cooperation.
- Interior Minister Driss Basri addresses congress of the workers' union, La Confederation Democratique du Travail.
- Princess Lalla Hasna inaugures private museum in Marrakesh.
- King Hussein meets Chinese ambassador An Guozheng.
- Morocco and Egypt agree on a meeting of the Jerusalem committee at the end of March.
- Spain's Telefonica firm seeks partnership with Morocco.
